archetypes.name: dyn-guideline-pin-race
archetypes.rationale: The changed pin helper intentionally collapses live diff refresh and durable note pinning into one snapshot.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the architectural-guidelines ship-time pin path for race and stale-artifact behavior. Check that a single materialized live diff is reused through staged refresh, durable note metadata, and later stale checks. Pay special attention to fallback behavior when live diff materialization is unavailable. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
